Inspired by a Vision for Better Learning

Founded under the guidance of Dr. Vijay Bhatkar, Vijaypath was created to make quality learning and educational opportunities more accessible to students.

With the collective support of educational institutions and academic communities, the initiative continues to expand its impact through technology-enabled learning and student-focused development.

A Visionary and Educationalist

Dr. Vijay Bhatkar

Scientist, educationalist, and lifelong learner whose contributions shaped India’s technology landscape. Vijaypath draws inspiration from his vision to digitally uplift students nationwide.

About Dr. Vijay Bhatkar View Courses

A Purpose-led Initiative

Initiative began with Dr. Vijay Bhatkar’s vision regarding quality education accessibility. Launched a Scholarship Guidance Program in Pune covering Marathi medium schools with Pune District Secondary and Higher Secondary School Headmasters Association support.

Our Mission

To provide affordable and quality scholarship guidance for every aspiring student.

Our Vision

To build a strong educational ecosystem through technology, schools, teachers, and parents.

Collective Efforts Towards the Mission

Partnership with Pune District Secondary and Higher Secondary School Headmasters Association working toward accessible education across Maharashtra. Headmasters Association coordinates ground-level implementation with schools and educators.

Maharashtra Expansion Vision

Initiative expanding beyond Pune across Maharashtra through collaboration with schools, educational coordinators, and academic experts. Plans include introducing new programs beyond scholarship preparation.

Free Online Talent Test for Class 4 and Class 7 Students

The Dr. Vijay Bhatkar Talent Test is a state-level online examination for SSC Board students from Marathi and English medium schools across Maharashtra.

Exam Date: 12 July 2026
Registration Closes: 08 July 2026
Mode: Online
Fee: Free
Register for Talent Test View Courses

Designed to Identify and Nurture Young Talent

The programme systematically prepares students through concept-based learning, regular practice, and guided support to strengthen subject knowledge and boost exam confidence.

Who Can Participate and What the Test Covers

Eligibility

  • Class 4 and Class 7 students only
  • SSC Board students from Maharashtra
  • Marathi and English medium schools
  • Students from recognized schools
  • Must appear for current class level

Subjects Covered

Science
Mathematics
General Knowledge
Aptitude & Intelligence

Understand the Test Format

Computer-based and mobile-based online examination through Mission VijayPath Platform with 75 MCQ-based questions across four subjects.

Pattern Overview

ModeComputer & Mobile-based Online
PlatformMission VijayPath Platform
Total Questions75 MCQs
Total Marks150 marks
Duration1 hour 30 minutes
Question TypeMCQ with single correct answer
Negative MarkingNo negative marking

Subject-wise Distribution

SubjectQuestionsMarks
Mathematics1530
Science1530
General Knowledge2040
Aptitude & Intelligence2550
Total75150

Difficulty Level

LevelPercentage
Easy30%
Medium50%
Difficult20%

Free Participation with District-Level Scholarship Awards

The examination is completely free. All eligible students can register without fees. Every participant receives a digital participation certificate after results declaration.

Awards & Benefits

StandardsClass 4 and Class 7
CoverageAll districts of Maharashtra
Winners per District3
AwardFree VijayPath Scholarship Program

Selection Criteria

  • Total marks obtained in examination
  • Number of correct answers
  • Performance in higher difficulty-level questions
  • Overall accuracy percentage
  • Time taken to complete examination

Registration Process

Step 1
Open the Registration Form

Click on the registration button on this page to begin.

Step 2
Fill in Student Details

Enter the student’s name, class, school, and contact information.

Step 3
Submit the Registration

Review and submit the form to complete registration.

Step 4
Receive Exam Instructions

Get login credentials and instructions before the test date.

Step 5
Appear for the Online Test

Log in on the exam day and complete the test online.
